buckets.descZh: 覆盖需求对齐 (/grill-with-docs)、领域建模、深模块架构、接缝驱动 TDD、双轴代码审查、Bug 诊断与拆单实施全链路。
buckets.descEn: Idea-to-ship spine: grilling with docs, domain modeling, deep modules, TDD, two-axis code review, debugging, and ticket execution.

buckets.descZh: 覆盖极限采访 (/grill-me)、跨会话交接 (/handoff)、苏格拉底教学 (/teach)、结构化问卷、反问纠偏 (/wait-what) 与 Agent 文档写作。
buckets.descEn: Non-code workflow tools: stateless grilling, session handoff, interactive teaching, questionnaires, and writing for agents.

buckets.descZh: 包含软件工厂 (/software-factory)、多线幕僚长 (/chief-of-staff)、双轨循环对撞 (/loop-me)、TS 深模块门禁与三阶段长文写作。
buckets.descEn: Public beta skills seeking feedback: software-factory, chief-of-staff, loop-me, TS deep-module checks, and long-form writing.

buckets.descZh: 包含危险 Git 命令拦截脚本、Husky Pre-commit 配置、测试断言 Shoehorn 迁移与练习题挖空脚手架生成。
buckets.descEn: Standalone utilities: dangerous git guardrails, Husky pre-commit setup, Shoehorn test migration, and exercise scaffolding.

promoted.descZh: 启用 Engineering 与 Productivity 全部正式发布技能（与上游插件默认集一致）。
promoted.descEn: All promoted Engineering and Productivity skills.

core.descZh: 仅启用高频 Idea-to-Ship 核心主干及其底层依赖原语，最大程度精简上下文。
core.descEn: Minimal high-frequency Idea-to-Ship spine and required primitives.

all.descZh: 启用全部 4 个分桶下的所有技能（含 In-Progress 与 Misc）。
all.descEn: Enable every skill across all 4 buckets including beta & misc.

mainFlow.descZh: 每个仓库只需跑一次（或在「项目工作台」可视化一键生成），配置 Issue Tracker、Triage 标签和术语表/ADR 路径。
mainFlow.descEn: Run once per repo (or use the visual Workspace Hub) to configure tracker, labels, and domain docs.
mainFlow.phaseTipZh: 一次性配置，写完后可直接在当前会话进入需求对齐。
mainFlow.phaseTipEn: One-time setup; proceed straight to grilling.

mainFlow.descZh: 在写任何代码前，围绕决策树逐轮追问直到消除歧义，同时将领域词汇写入 GLOSSARY.md、重大取舍沉淀为 ADR。
mainFlow.descEn: Interview round by round until the design tree settles; update GLOSSARY.md & ADRs inline.
mainFlow.phaseTipZh: 上下文保鲜：步骤 1→3 尽量保持在同一会话不断开，逼近 150k Smart Zone 再 /compact。
mainFlow.phaseTipEn: Keep steps 1–3 in one unbroken context; use /compact if approaching context limit.

mainFlow.descZh: 如果状态机手感或 UI 布局难以纸上谈兵，先用 /handoff 分叉到独立原型，验证后再将结论合回主线。
mainFlow.descEn: When paper reasoning fails, fork via /handoff to a throwaway HTML/UI prototype and fold findings back.
mainFlow.phaseTipZh: 建议搭配 /handoff + 新开会话运行原型，避免污染主设计线程。
mainFlow.phaseTipEn: Pair with /handoff in a fresh conversation to keep main thread clean.

mainFlow.descZh: 不额外追问，直接把已达成共识的讨论、测试接缝 (Seams) 与约束收敛为正式 Spec 发布到 Tracker。
mainFlow.descEn: Synthesize aligned decisions and high-leverage test seams into a structured Spec.
mainFlow.phaseTipZh: 在同一个上下文紧接 Grill-with-Docs 执行。
mainFlow.phaseTipEn: Run immediately after grilling in the same session.

mainFlow.descZh: 把 Spec 拆成端到端可验证的 Tracer-Bullet 票据并标明 Blocked by 依赖边，形成可并发的 Ready Frontier。
mainFlow.descEn: Split the Spec into vertical tracer-bullet tickets with explicit blocking edges.
mainFlow.phaseTipZh: 拆单完成后，每张票据自包含，适合开新会话或用 /implement-spec 并发执行！
mainFlow.phaseTipEn: Once tickets are written, start a fresh session per ticket or run /implement-spec.

mainFlow.descZh: 单票据新会话用 /implement，整套 Spec 用 /implement-spec（原生 Workspace="share" 并发派发子代理）；内部自动驱动 /tdd。
mainFlow.descEn: Run /implement per ticket in a fresh conversation, or /implement-spec for parallel DAG execution.
mainFlow.phaseTipZh: 单票据完成后建议新开会话处理下一票据，保持在黄金推理区。
mainFlow.phaseTipEn: Start a fresh conversation between tickets to stay in the smart zone.

mainFlow.descZh: 并行拉起 mp-standards-reviewer 与 mp-spec-reviewer 分别审查规范坏味道与规格符合度，再用 pr 技能生成清晰 PR 描述。
mainFlow.descEn: Parallel Standards + Spec subagent review, followed by crisp PR body with evidence.
mainFlow.phaseTipZh: 双轴结果严格分列，防止代码整洁掩盖需求遗漏。
mainFlow.phaseTipEn: Reports stay separate so clean style never hides missing spec requirements.

mainFlow.descZh: 在刚结束实施的当前会话内运行 /retro，把暴露出来的环境摩擦固化为自动化检查或规则文档改进。
mainFlow.descEn: Run in the active session to turn friction into deterministic checks and better steering docs.
mainFlow.phaseTipZh: 务必在清空或结束会话前就地运行，效果最佳。
mainFlow.phaseTipEn: Run before closing the session so lessons capture real friction.

onRamps.titleZh: 外部 Issue / PR 分诊入口
onRamps.descZh: 对外部提交的缺陷报告或 PR 进行查重、复现验证并产出 Agent-Ready 简报，再无缝接入 /implement。
onRamps.descEn: Check duplicates, reproduce claims, grill gaps, and produce agent-ready briefs.

onRamps.titleZh: 疑难 Bug 闭环诊断入口
onRamps.descZh: 拒绝盲猜：先写一个稳定复现的红灯命令，再最小化隔离、加探针定位根因并补充回归测试。
onRamps.descEn: Establish a deterministic red reproducer first, minimize, instrument, fix, and test.

onRamps.titleZh: 超大跨会话模糊工程领航
onRamps.descZh: 当项目大到单次会话装不下时，在 Tracker 建立决策票据地图，逐个消除未知迷雾后再合流到 /to-spec。
onRamps.descEn: Chart a decision-ticket map on your tracker for oversized foggy initiatives before /to-spec.

phaseBoundaries.whenZh: 刚完成前置依赖且上下文充裕，继续留在原窗口成本最低。
phaseBoundaries.whenEn: Context is fresh and tightly coupled to the next step.

phaseBoundaries.whenZh: 接近上下文上限但仍需保留主干决策脉络继续推导。
phaseBoundaries.whenEn: Approaching context limits mid-flow while needing summary continuity.

phaseBoundaries.whenZh: 已产出自包含的 Ticket / Spec 文件，下一阶段需要干净推理窗口。
phaseBoundaries.whenEn: Tickets/specs are persisted; ideal between /implement runs.

phaseBoundaries.whenZh: 需要跨目录（如去原型分支）、换工具或把半途进度转给下一个 Agent。
phaseBoundaries.whenEn: Switching directories, tools, or forking a side exploration.

phaseBoundaries.whenZh: 需要独立隔离大块读盘/调研/审查（mp-researcher / mp-explorer / 双轴审查）。
phaseBoundaries.whenEn: Isolate heavy reading, web research, or parallel code review.

skills.name: ask-matt
skills.description: Ask which skill or flow fits your situation. A router over the skills in this repo.
skills.zhSummary: 技能路由器：根据当前研发场景推荐最匹配的技能组合与阶段边界决策
skills.enSummary: Route your current task to the right skill flow and phase-boundary choice.
skills.samplePrompt: /ask-matt 我想给当前项目加一个新模块，不确定先走哪一步

skills.name: code-review
skills.description: Review the changes since a fixed point (commit, branch, tag, or merge-base) along two axes: Standards (does the code follow this repo's documented coding standards?) and Spec (does the code match what the originating issue/spec asked for?). Runs both reviews in parallel sub-agents and reports them side by side. Use when the user wants to review a branch, a PR, work-in-progress changes, or asks to "review since X".
skills.zhSummary: 双子代理并发审查：沿「编码规范与 Fowler 坏味道」与「规格符合度」双轴独立出报告
skills.enSummary: Two-axis parallel diff review (Standards + Fowler smells vs Spec compliance).
skills.samplePrompt: Run code-review against main

skills.name: codebase-design
skills.description: Shared vocabulary for designing deep modules. Use when the user wants to design or improve a module's interface, find deepening opportunities, decide where a seam goes, make code more testable or AI-navigable, or when another skill needs the deep-module vocabulary.
skills.zhSummary: 深模块架构设计词汇表：基于 module、interface、seam、leverage 设计简洁边界
skills.enSummary: Deep-module architecture vocabulary and design-it-twice parallel exploration pattern.
skills.samplePrompt: Apply codebase-design principles to deepen this module interface

skills.name: diagnosing-bugs
skills.description: Diagnosis loop for hard bugs and performance regressions. Use when the user says "diagnose"/"debug this", or reports something broken/throwing/failing/slow.
skills.zhSummary: 紧反馈闭环 Bug 诊断：先建立稳定复现红灯命令，再最小化定位根因并补回归测试
skills.enSummary: Disciplined bug loop: build a red reproducer first, minimize, instrument, fix, test.
skills.samplePrompt: Use diagnosing-bugs to investigate this intermittent failure

skills.name: domain-modeling
skills.description: Build and sharpen a project's domain model. Use when discussing codebase terminology, writing or editing a GLOSSARY.md, or recording or editing an ADR.
skills.zhSummary: 领域建模与通用语言：提炼 Glossary 术语表并将不可逆架构决策沉淀为 ADR
skills.enSummary: Sharpen ubiquitous language in GLOSSARY.md and record hard-to-reverse decisions as ADRs.
skills.samplePrompt: Use domain-modeling to audit overloaded terms in our GLOSSARY.md

skills.name: grill-with-docs
skills.description: A relentless interview to sharpen a plan or design, which also creates docs (ADR's and glossary) as we go.
skills.zhSummary: 结合 grilling 与领域建模对方案进行极限采访，并将术语表与 ADR 决策落盘
skills.enSummary: Relentless design interview that sharpens GLOSSARY.md and ADRs inline.
skills.samplePrompt: /grill-with-docs 我们准备重构订单结算状态机

skills.name: implement
skills.description: Implement a piece of work based on a spec or set of tickets.
skills.zhSummary: 按 Spec 或单个 Ticket 实施交付：沿接缝驱动 TDD 并在收尾运行双轴 Code Review
skills.enSummary: Implement a spec or ticket with seam-driven TDD and close out with code-review.
skills.samplePrompt: /implement

skills.name: implement-spec
skills.description: Implement the result of /to-spec and /to-tickets in code.
skills.zhSummary: 任务图并发编排：基于就绪前沿并行派发子代理在独立工作区完成整套 Spec 并合入主干
skills.enSummary: Orchestrate a whole spec DAG across concurrent subagents in shared workspaces.
skills.samplePrompt: /implement-spec

skills.name: improve-codebase-architecture
skills.description: Scan a codebase for deepening opportunities, present them as a visual HTML report, then grill through whichever one you pick.
skills.zhSummary: 深模块架构巡检：定位浅层模块与耦合热点，生成可视化 HTML 报告并逐项追问重构
skills.enSummary: Scan codebase hotspots for deepening candidates, render HTML report, and grill choices.
skills.samplePrompt: /improve-codebase-architecture

skills.name: pr
skills.description: Use when writing a PR body.
skills.zhSummary: PR 描述塑形器：最小可视化变更图、前后验证证据以及单向/双向门合并风险评估
skills.enSummary: Craft concise PR descriptions with visuals, verification proof, and merge-danger call.
skills.samplePrompt: Draft a PR description for this branch following pr skill

skills.name: prototype
skills.description: Build a throwaway prototype to answer a design question. Use when the user wants to sanity-check whether a state model or logic feels right, or explore what a UI should look like.
skills.zhSummary: 抛出式原型验证：生成可交互单文件 HTML 状态模型或可切换的多套 UI 方案变体
skills.enSummary: Build throwaway HTML state demos or multi-variation UI routes to settle design questions.
skills.samplePrompt: Build a throwaway logic prototype to verify this state machine

skills.name: research
skills.description: Investigate a question against high-trust primary sources and capture the findings as a Markdown file in the repo. Use when the user wants a topic researched, docs or API facts gathered, or reading legwork delegated to a background agent.
skills.zhSummary: 后台一手资料调研：通过 mp-researcher 联网溯源官方文档/源码并输出带引用的 Markdown
skills.enSummary: Delegate primary-source investigation to mp-researcher and save a cited Markdown note.
skills.samplePrompt: Research the official specification for ... using mp-researcher

skills.name: retro
skills.description: Conduct a retrospective on a coding session.
skills.zhSummary: 会话工程复盘：从本次开发摩擦中提炼对导航文档、自动化门禁与规则文件的持久化改进
skills.enSummary: Post-session retrospective improving agent navigation, automated checks, and steering docs.
skills.samplePrompt: /retro

skills.name: setup-matt-pocock-skills
skills.description: Configure this repo for the engineering skills: set up its issue tracker, triage label vocabulary, and domain doc layout. Run once before first use of the other engineering skills.
skills.zhSummary: 仓库初始化向导：配置 Issue Tracker、Triage 标签词汇与领域文档 (GLOSSARY/ADR) 布局
skills.enSummary: Configure repo issue tracker, triage labels, and domain doc layout (GLOSSARY/ADR).
skills.samplePrompt: /setup-matt-pocock-skills

skills.name: tdd
skills.description: Test-driven development. Use when the user wants to build features or fix bugs test-first, mentions "red-green-refactor", or wants integration tests.
skills.zhSummary: 严格红-绿-重构 TDD 循环：一次一个垂直行为切片，围绕公共接口而非内部实现测试
skills.enSummary: Strict red-green-refactor loop building vertical slices through public interfaces.
skills.samplePrompt: Use tdd to implement this behavior one red-green slice at a time

skills.name: to-spec
skills.description: Turn the current conversation into a spec and publish it to the project issue tracker: no interview, just synthesis of what you've already discussed.
skills.zhSummary: 将当前对齐讨论直接综合为结构化 Spec 规格书并发布至项目 Issue Tracker
skills.enSummary: Synthesize the aligned discussion into a formal spec and publish to the issue tracker.
skills.samplePrompt: /to-spec

skills.name: to-tickets
skills.description: Break a plan, spec, or the current conversation into a set of tracer-bullet tickets, each declaring its blocking edges, published to the configured tracker (edges as text in one file per ticket locally, or native blocking links on a real tracker).
skills.zhSummary: 将 Spec 拆解为带前置阻塞边 (Blocked by) 的 Tracer-Bullet 垂直切片任务票据
skills.enSummary: Break a spec into vertical tracer-bullet tickets with explicit blocking edges.
skills.samplePrompt: /to-tickets

skills.name: triage
skills.description: Move issues and external PRs through a state machine of triage roles, categorise, verify, grill if needed, and write agent-ready briefs.
skills.zhSummary: Issue/PR 分诊状态机：查重、验证复现、追问并将成熟诉求转为 Agent-Ready 简报
skills.enSummary: Evaluate incoming issues/PRs through triage roles and produce agent-ready briefs.
skills.samplePrompt: /triage Show me anything that needs my attention

skills.name: wayfinder
skills.description: Plan a huge chunk of work (more than one agent session can hold) as a shared map of decision tickets on your issue tracker, and resolve them one at a time until the way to the destination is clear.
skills.zhSummary: 大型模糊项目领航图：在 Tracker 上构建决策票据 DAG，逐个消除迷雾后再转入 Spec
skills.enSummary: Chart a multi-session decision map on your tracker to clear fog before building.
skills.samplePrompt: /wayfinder

skills.name: wizard
skills.description: Generate an interactive bash wizard that walks a human through steps only they can perform. Use when provisioning infrastructure, setting up credentials or CI secrets, walking an unfamiliar third-party dashboard, or running a one-off migration or cutover. Don't invoke this for steps the agent can perform itself.
skills.zhSummary: 人工兜底交互脚本生成器：为建库、配密钥或控制台操作生成可复用的 Bash 引导向导
skills.enSummary: Generate an interactive bash wizard for human-only setup steps and credential capture.
skills.samplePrompt: Create a setup wizard script for provisioning these CI secrets

skills.name: grill-me
skills.description: A relentless interview to sharpen a plan or design.
skills.zhSummary: 无状态极限采访：针对任意方案或写作大纲按决策树逐层追问（提示：内置同名，代码库推荐用 /grill-with-docs）
skills.enSummary: Stateless relentless design-tree interview (note: Antigravity also has a built-in /grill-me).
skills.collisionNote: Antigravity 内置已有同名 /grill-me；代码库中建议优先用 /grill-with-docs，或点名 mattpocock-skills:grill-me。
skills.samplePrompt: Use mattpocock-skills:grill-me to stress-test this plan

skills.name: grilling
skills.description: Grill the user relentlessly about a plan, decision, or idea. Use when the user wants to stress-test their thinking, or uses any 'grill' trigger phrases.
skills.zhSummary: 底层采访原语：按决策树前沿 (Frontier) 分轮提问并附推荐答案，查证事实绝不推给用户
skills.enSummary: Reusable frontier-by-frontier interview primitive behind grill-me and grill-with-docs.
skills.samplePrompt: Interview me using grilling one frontier round at a time

skills.name: handoff
skills.description: Compact the current conversation into a handoff document for another agent to pick up.
skills.argumentHint: What will the next session be used for?
skills.zhSummary: 跨会话交接文档：将当前上下文浓缩为便携 Markdown 存入临时目录供新会话无缝接棒
skills.enSummary: Compact current context into a portable OS-temp handoff doc for a fresh session.
skills.samplePrompt: /handoff Continue implementing ticket 03 in a fresh session

skills.name: teach
skills.description: Teach the user a new skill or concept, within this workspace.
skills.argumentHint: What would you like to learn about?
skills.zhSummary: 苏格拉底式多会话教学：将当前目录变成状态化学习工作区，记录学习档案与关卡任务
skills.enSummary: Multi-session interactive tutor turning the workspace into a stateful learning studio.
skills.samplePrompt: /teach Teach me Effect-TS error modeling step by step

skills.name: to-questionnaire
skills.description: Turn a decision you can't fully answer into a questionnaire for someone else to fill in.
skills.zhSummary: 对外协同问卷生成：先反向盘问发给谁与缺什么信息，再产出给相关方的 Markdown 问卷
skills.enSummary: Grill you on the recipient and missing gaps, then emit a crisp async questionnaire.
skills.samplePrompt: /to-questionnaire Draft questions for the backend team about webhook retries

skills.name: wait-what
skills.description: Stop. That last message did not land: re-pitch it.
skills.zhSummary: 实时术语纠偏器：当你没听懂上一段回复时触发，用 GLOSSARY 大白话重讲缺失的前置上下文
skills.enSummary: Re-pitch a confusing reply in plain English with missing context and GLOSSARY terms.
skills.samplePrompt: /wait-what

skills.name: writing-for-agents
skills.description: Writing documents for agents. Use when creating or editing skills, or modifying AGENTS.md or CLAUDE.md.
skills.zhSummary: 面向 Agent 的文档写作规范：SKILL.md 触发描述、AGENTS.md 指针结构与渐进披露原则
skills.enSummary: Best practices for authoring SKILL.md, AGENTS.md, and agent-consumed pointer docs.
skills.samplePrompt: Review this SKILL.md using writing-for-agents principles

skills.name: chief-of-staff
skills.description: Pursue a long-running goal in a single session by co-ordinating subagents.
skills.zhSummary: 个人/团队多线幕僚长：跨 GitHub、日程与个人 Wiki 统筹优先级、草拟回复与跟进事项
skills.enSummary: Multi-stream chief-of-staff orchestrating priorities across repos, wikis, and comms.
skills.samplePrompt: /chief-of-staff

skills.name: claude-handoff
skills.description: Hand the current conversation off to a fresh background agent that picks up the work immediately.
skills.argumentHint: What will the next session be used for?
skills.zhSummary: 会话交接变体（实验）：带特定格式锚点的交接备忘生成（在 Antigravity 中可参考 handoff）
skills.enSummary: Experimental session handoff variant with structured handover anchors.
skills.samplePrompt: /claude-handoff

skills.name: loop-me
skills.description: Grill me about specs for the workflows I want to build, within this workspace.
skills.argumentHint: A workflow to design, or nothing to go find one
skills.zhSummary: 双轨循环对撞：围绕同一目标持续在「改进尝试 ↔ 严格验收」之间自动循环迭代直至过关
skills.enSummary: Iterative self-looping driver between execution attempts and strict verification.
skills.samplePrompt: /loop-me Fix all failing integration tests until green

skills.name: setup-ts-deep-modules
skills.description: Wire dependency-cruiser into a TypeScript repo so each package is a deep module, with implementation hidden in subfolders and reachable only through its entry-point files. User-invoked.
skills.zhSummary: TypeScript 深模块架构门禁：接入 dependency-cruiser 规则防止跨层循环依赖与边界泄漏
skills.enSummary: Configure dependency-cruiser rules in TS repos to enforce deep module boundaries.
skills.samplePrompt: /setup-ts-deep-modules

skills.name: software-factory
skills.description: Shared language for designing a software factory: the tasks it runs and the services it plugs into.
skills.zhSummary: 无人值守软件工厂：串联可观测平台、Git 宿主、工单系统与自动化 Runner 闭环交付
skills.enSummary: End-to-end autonomous software factory wiring observability, trackers, and runners.
skills.samplePrompt: Consult software-factory to design an autonomous bugfix pipeline

skills.name: writing-beats
skills.description: Writing, exploit; assemble raw material into a journey of beats, grounding each term before a beat leans on it.
skills.zhSummary: 三阶段长文写作 · 第一步节拍（Beats）：把零散观点组织成节奏清晰、逻辑递进的叙事节拍表
skills.enSummary: Long-form writing stage 1: organize raw ideas into clear narrative beats.
skills.samplePrompt: Use writing-beats to structure the narrative flow for this article

skills.name: writing-fragments
skills.description: Writing, explore: mine raw fragments, no structure yet.
skills.zhSummary: 三阶段长文写作 · 第二步素材碎片（Fragments）：收集例证、金句与真实代码片段填充节拍
skills.enSummary: Long-form writing stage 2: gather concrete examples and code fragments per beat.
skills.samplePrompt: Use writing-fragments to draft raw examples for each beat

skills.name: writing-shape
skills.description: Writing, exploit: shape raw material into an article, paragraph by paragraph.
skills.zhSummary: 三阶段长文写作 · 第三步成稿塑形（Shape）：基于节拍与碎片锻造紧致有冲击力的终稿
skills.enSummary: Long-form writing stage 3: shape beats and fragments into tight final prose.
skills.samplePrompt: Use writing-shape to polish these beats and fragments into a draft
